org.reg.empty.body: Add the tax number and the social security registrations of this company.
org.bank.help: Accounts the company pays salaries from. Numbers are stored encrypted. A new, changed or removed account waits for a second administrator while approval of sensitive changes is on.
org.bank.approval: Payment details can be used to pay people. When approval is on, a second administrator must approve this before it takes effect.
org.bank.noBanks: No banks are installed yet. The country pack brings the list of banks.
org.bank.title: Account title
org.bank.number.keep: Leave empty to keep the number as it is.
org.bank.iban.help: Optional. Spaces are ignored; the check digits are verified.
org.bank.format.help: Optional. The code of the template that writes the salary file for this bank.
org.bank.reason.help: Optional. The second administrator sees it with the request.
org.bank.removeEffect: The account can no longer be used for salary payments. Earlier payments keep their record.
org.bank.empty.body: Add the account the company pays salaries from.
org.bank.waiting: The change is waiting for a second administrator. Find it under Approvals.
org.settings.title: Settings that differ for this company
org.settings.link: Open the settings centre for this company
org.settings.none: This company uses the same settings as the whole customer.
org.settings.denied: The list could not be shown. The settings centre has it.
org.letterhead.help: The letterhead is a template in the template editor.
org.logo.saveFirst: Save the company first; then you can add its logo.
locations.description: The sites of your companies: address, time zone and opening hours.
locations.help.region: The province or state code, for example SD or PB.
locations.help.latitude: A number from -90 to 90, for example 24.8607. Paste it from any map.
locations.help.longitude: A number from -180 to 180, for example 67.0011.
locations.help.branch: The branch the site belongs to.
locations.hours.help: Leave a day empty when the opening hours are not stated. Times are 24-hour, for example 09:00.
locations.hours.format: Write the time as hours and minutes, for example 09:00.
locations.hours.order: The opening time must be before the closing time.
locations.delete.body: The location {location} will be removed from the lists. Records that refer to it keep their history.
calendars.description: Holiday calendars for companies and sites. The working-day rules of approvals and attendance skip these days.
calendars.help.country: Two letters, for example PK. Leave empty for a calendar that is not tied to one country.
calendars.pack: This calendar comes with a country pack
calendars.pack.body: It cannot be changed here. Make a calendar of your own for dates that differ.
calendars.copied: {created} holidays were copied from {from} to {to}; {skipped} were left as they were. Dates that follow the moon are marked tentative.
calendars.help.tentative: A date that depends on the moon is tentative until it is confirmed. Confirm it when the date is announced.
calendars.holiday.name: Name
calendars.holiday.tentativeSwitch: The date is tentative (depends on the moon)
calendars.confirmTitle: Confirm the date of a holiday
calendars.duplicate: This calendar already has a holiday on that date.
calendars.empty.body: Add the holidays of this year, or copy them from the year before.
calendars.usedBy.none: No company or location uses this calendar yet. Choose it on the company or location.
units.description: Divisions, departments and teams of your companies. Where a unit sits in the structure is set on the org chart, from a date.
units.help.code: A short code, unique within the company.
units.help.site: The site where the unit is based. Optional.
units.created: The unit {unit} was created. Place it on the org chart.
units.deactivated: The unit {unit} was deactivated. It keeps its place and its history.
units.delete.body: Delete the unit {unit}? Its history stays in the audit log. A unit that other records refer to cannot be deleted; deactivate it instead.
unitTypes.description: The kinds of unit in your structure, such as division, department and team. There is no limit to the depth.
unitTypes.rename.help: (for example Department to Wing) in the labels editor of the settings centre.
unitTypes.help.level: Optional: a usual depth (1 for the top), only a hint for sorting.
unitTypes.activated: The unit type {type} is active again.
hierarchies.description: The structures your units can be arranged in. A new kind of hierarchy needs a change request.
hierarchies.help.kind: Reporting lines, legal entities or geography.
chart.title: Org chart
chart.description: Your units as they stood on a chosen date. Move a unit from a date and compare two dates.
chart.asOf.help: Choose a past or future date to see the structure then.
chart.drag.help: Drag a unit onto its new parent, or select it and use Move to… (the same steps from the keyboard).
chart.tree.label: Units
chart.chart.label: Org chart
chart.select.hint: Select a unit to see its details and to move it.
chart.showInTree: Open the tree down to this unit
chart.unplaced.help: These units have no place on the chosen date. Place them under a parent or at the top.
chart.nothingPlaced: No unit has a place in this hierarchy on this date.
chart.empty.body: Create units first, then place them on this chart.
chart.move.title: Move {unit}
chart.place.title: Place {unit}
chart.move.effect: {unit} and everything below it move to the new parent from the date you choose. Before that date the old parent still applies, and the history is kept.
chart.place.effect: {unit} gets its place in this hierarchy from the date you choose.
chart.move.parent.help: Only units of the same company can be chosen. Choose Top level to make it a root.
chart.move.date.help: The new parent applies from this day; the day before keeps the old one.
chart.move.failed: The move could not be made. Try again.
chart.compare.title: Compare two dates
approvals.changes.kind.hrm.policy.versio: Put a new version of the policy {subject} in force
approvals.changes.kind.hrm.policy.assign: Put new assignments of {subject} policies in force
